verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own forms page says all business forms can be submitted by mail or in person, and its service options name a Sacramento drop-off service, so a documented non-online fallback exists. The evidence does not show the exact mailing or drop-off addresses, any fax number, or which specific form maps to which online task. Missing for 10: exact mailing and street addresses, a fax channel or number, a form-by-form list of paper equivalents, and independent confirmation that the paper rail works.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: All business forms can be submitted by mail or in person.
4–Hour Filing Service (Class A) - $500.00: Drop-Off-Only in Sacramento.
